wordpress.name: WordPress
wordpress.bestFor: Blogs, course sites, membership sites, WooCommerce stores
wordpress.difficulty: Beginner-friendly with themes, moderate for customization
wordpress.creatorUseCase: Blog for SEO traffic, course hosting with LearnDash/Tutor LMS, membership with MemberPress, affiliate sites

shopify.name: Shopify
shopify.bestFor: Merch stores, digital product sales, dropshipping
shopify.creatorUseCase: Merchandise store, print-on-demand with Printful/Printify, digital downloads, branded products

webflow.name: Webflow
webflow.bestFor: Portfolio sites, landing pages, brand sites with custom design
webflow.creatorUseCase: Professional portfolio, media kit hosting, brand website, course landing pages

squarespace.name: Squarespace
squarespace.bestFor: Beautiful portfolio sites, simple stores, personal brands
squarespace.creatorUseCase: Personal brand site, portfolio, simple merch store, link-in-bio replacement

wix.name: Wix
wix.bestFor: Quick personal sites, small business sites
wix.creatorUseCase: Quick personal site, event pages, simple landing pages
cons: Not great for SEO at scale

framer.name: Framer
framer.bestFor: Modern animated sites, SaaS landing pages, creator portfolios
framer.creatorUseCase: Stunning portfolio, animated landing page, waitlist page, modern brand site

ghost.name: Ghost
ghost.creatorUseCase: Paid newsletter, premium blog, membership content, SEO-driven content marketing

carrd.name: Carrd
carrd.creatorUseCase: Link-in-bio replacement, email capture page, waitlist page, simple portfolio

gumroad.name: Gumroad
gumroad.bestFor: Selling digital products, courses, ebooks, templates
gumroad.creatorUseCase: Course sales, ebook/PDF sales, template packs, preset sales, digital downloads

teachable.name: Teachable
teachable.creatorUseCase: Video courses, coaching programs, bundled course packages, certification programs

kajabi.name: Kajabi
kajabi.bestFor: Full creator business (courses + community + email + site)
kajabi.creatorUseCase: All-in-one: courses, memberships, email marketing, landing pages, podcasts, community

stan.name: Stan Store
stan.bestFor: Link-in-bio store, digital product sales, booking
stan.creatorUseCase: Link-in-bio with checkout, course sales, 1-on-1 booking, digital downloads, email capture

nextjs.name: Next.js
nextjs.bestFor: Full-stack web apps, SEO-critical sites, SaaS products
nextjs.creatorUseCase: Custom course platform, membership site, analytics dashboard, full creator business site

astro.name: Astro
astro.creatorUseCase: SEO blog for organic traffic, documentation site, portfolio with blog
astro.stack: Astro + Tailwind CSS + MDX + Cloudflare Pages

remix.name: Remix
remix.bestFor: Complex web apps with forms, auth, real-time features
remix.creatorUseCase: Custom community platform, interactive tools, creator dashboards

html_css_js.name: HTML + CSS + JavaScript
html_css_js.bestFor: Simple landing pages, link-in-bio, email templates
html_css_js.creatorUseCase: Custom link-in-bio page, email template, simple landing page, media kit page

python_flask.name: Python (Flask/Django)
python_flask.bestFor: Custom APIs, data dashboards, AI-powered tools
python_flask.creatorUseCase: YouTube analytics dashboard, AI content tools, custom automation APIs, data-driven sites

starter.why: Zero to low cost, set up in 30 minutes, captures emails from day one

builder.why: SEO blog drives free traffic. Start building email list. WordPress if you want courses later, Ghost if newsletter-first.

grower.why: Course launch platform. WordPress if you want control, Kajabi if you want all-in-one convenience.

scaler.why: Custom platform = full brand control + unique features competitors can't copy. Shopify for merch.

operator.why: At this scale, you need a custom platform that handles your specific business model. Hire a developer or agency.

byGoal.seo_traffic: WordPress or Astro — best SEO capabilities
byGoal.sell_courses: Teachable (easy) or WordPress + LearnDash (flexible) or Kajabi (all-in-one)
byGoal.newsletter_business: Ghost or Substack (free) or ConvertKit (with landing pages)
byGoal.link_in_bio: Carrd ($9/year) or Stan Store ($29/mo with checkout)
byGoal.full_business: Kajabi (no-code) or Next.js custom build (full control)
